title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.61
body_markdown:
* Added: Support GPT-5.1 GPT-5.1-Codex GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini models (Preview).
* Fixed: Agent mode acts as ask mode.
* Fixed: Custom agent feature is missing.
* Fixed: Code lens to edit custom agent tools.
* Fixed: Cannot run subagent with auto model.
* Fixed: Model picker switched to auto unexpectedly.
* Fixed:​ Commands not in terminal-specific rules are now auto-approved by your general setting.
body_html:
• Added: Support GPT-5.1 GPT-5.1-Codex GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini models (Preview).
  • Fixed: Agent mode acts as ask mode.
  • Fixed: Custom agent feature is missing.
  • Fixed: Code lens to edit custom agent tools.
  • Fixed: Cannot run subagent with auto model.
  • Fixed: Model picker switched to auto unexpectedly.
  • Fixed:​ Commands not in terminal-specific rules are now auto-approved by your general setting.
